$description:
Marker contract — the tiny NON-interactive labeled chip (keycap, badge, chip,
tag, inline code). Presentational; no state.

Lean by design (see the taxonomy spec): semantics carry the whole look — the
recipe reads --a63-surface-muted (bg), --a63-text-secondary (fg),
--a63-border-subtle (border), --a63-control-radius (radius) and
--a63-control-font-family (→ terminal-mono for free) at the use-site. The ONE
thing themes vary distinctly for a keycap is its BEVEL, so that is the only
contract token here.

--a63-marker-shadow is a static keycap shadow (mode-independent), so it's safe
to default at :root. Default is `none` — modern and terminal are flat pills
(spec: "terminal none"); aqua and retro give it keycap character.

shadow.$description:
`0 0 #0000` rather than `none`: recipes compose this into comma-separated
   box-shadow lists (e.g. `var(--a63-marker-shadow), <focus ring>`), and `none`
   is only legal as the sole value — it would invalidate the whole declaration
   and silently drop the focus ring. This paints nothing.
